Done. I've implemented all three functions:

1. **formatBytes** (src/util.js:1-15) — converts byte counts to B/KB/MB/GB with one decimal place (e.g., "1.5 MB")
2. **slugify** (src/text.js:1-10) — lowercases, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, strips non-alphanumeric characters except dashes
3. **fetchUsers** (src/api.js:1-11) — GETs from `${baseUrl}/api/users`, parses JSON, logs the user count, returns the array

All are exported from their modules.
